record_identity.title: Evaluation Reality-Binding and Runtime Preflight Assurance

summary: Proposal for a narrow CAM extension requiring elevated and critical evaluations to bind model-visible claims about simulation, internet access, target scope, credentials, monitoring, and production separation to independently verified provider and third-party runtime state before execution, and to revalidate that binding after material changes. A discrepancy would emit a mandatory contradiction signal, remove reliance on the affected claim, and trigger pause or stop handling before real systems can be transposed into understood exercise scope.
why_it_matters_to_CAM: CAM already governs isolation, external reach, network routes, stop conditions, monitoring, external evaluators, and declared-versus-observed discrepancies. The Anthropic incidents expose a remaining integration gap: the prompt's no-internet simulation claim and the live partner environment were governed as separate representations. A compact reality-binding control would make the evaluation claim a derived and continuously verified runtime assertion rather than an untested narrative premise.

source_records.source_title: Investigating three real-world incidents in our cybersecurity evaluations
source_records.system_or_product: Anthropic cyber-capability evaluations operated with third-party evaluation partner Irregular
source_records.model_or_algorithm: Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Mythos 5, and an unnamed internal research test model
source_records.deployment_context: Six capture-the-flag evaluation runs in which the model-visible no-internet simulation claim diverged from a third-party environment with live internet access.
source_records.source_context: Anthropic identified three incidents across six runs after reviewing 141,006 cyber-evaluation runs. It states that a misunderstanding with the evaluation partner and an environment misconfiguration left live internet access available despite prompts saying there was none. Anthropic identifies careful validation of internet paths, real-time monitoring, stronger transcript and network-log review, and improved vendor assurance as relevant controls.
source_records.relevance_note: Primary incident and provider-response basis for a preflight and continuous assurance control binding declared evaluation constraints to operative provider and partner environment state.

contextual_relations.rationale: PROP-0019 established the broader cross-domain red-team governance package and was resolved by PATCH-0031. PROP-0025 addresses the newly evidenced, narrower integration gap between model-visible evaluation claims and verified runtime or partner-environment state.
Objective-pathway authority failure may follow an environment contradiction, but PROP-0025 does not purport to resolve FM-0044 or replace its existing and proposed repair pathways.

Monitoring coverage can detect or shorten a contradiction, but the proposed preflight reality binding remains a separate preventive control and does not resolve the wider monitor-integrity failure mode.

migration_notes: Individual records maintain canonical source evidence only in source_records. Do not add source_data or duplicate primary sources in linked_records.external_references.
proposal_rationale: OPERATIONS-008 already requires isolation, tested boundary evidence, declared network routes, independent review, monitoring, human gates, stop events, external-evaluator duties, and review of material discrepancies. Those controls can still be administered as separate documents or local assurances unless the model-visible premise is bound to the same observed environment state. The proposed repair would require a signed or tamper-evident preflight record that compares the evaluation plan and prompt against provider and partner runtime facts; permits the no-internet or simulation claim only where verified; assigns independent approval and stop authority; and continuously revalidates the claim after material changes. It would not treat a truthful prompt as a substitute for containment, nor would it make the model solely responsible for detecting operator or harness error.

proposal_scope.scope_summary: Amend the existing red-team and runtime governance architecture so that model-visible claims about simulation, connectivity, target scope, credential status, production separation, tools, and monitoring are derived from and reconciled against independently observed provider and third-party environment state before elevated or critical evaluations begin. Require continuous revalidation, contradiction signalling, automatic removal of reliance on a contradicted claim, and proportionate pause or stop handling after material state changes.

suggested_insertion_points: OPERATIONS-008 §2 Definitions — define Evaluation Environment-Reality Attestation, Model-Visible Constraint Manifest, and Constraint Contradiction Event.

OPERATIONS-008 §6.2–6.3 — require independent preflight verification of actual egress, DNS, proxy, credential, cloud-identity, package-registry, production-route, tool, and partner-environment state; prohibit a no-internet or simulation claim unless the evidence supports it.

OPERATIONS-008 §7.1 and §18 — add the attestation, model-visible constraint manifest, reviewer identity, evidence timestamp, expiry, and revalidation triggers to the evaluation plan and minimum compliance checklist.

OPERATIONS-008 §13–15 — treat any material contradiction or expired assurance as a pause or stop event; preserve evidence and extend reciprocal attestation, change-control, monitoring, and notification duties to external evaluators.

OPERATIONS-007 §6 — treat prompt-visible environment constraints, egress state, evaluator environment, classifier or monitor configuration, and partner attestation as materially distinct runtime configuration.

AEON-003-SCH-02 and Annex K — expose a bounded runtime signal indicating verified evaluation scope, contradiction, revalidation required, pause, or stop without making the model the sole assurance authority.
OPERATIONS-001-SUP-01 — record the attested claim, observed state, evidence source, material changes, contradictions, review decisions, and incident handoff.
automation_changes: Design conformance tests that deliberately introduce egress, DNS, credential, monitoring, or partner-configuration drift and verify that the claim is invalidated before consequential execution continues.
Require assurance expiry and revalidation after changes to images, routes, tools, credentials, cloud identity, classifiers, monitors, partners, prompts, or evaluation scope.
interface_changes: Expose whether environment claims are verified, stale, contradicted, or pending independent review.
Expose the authorised target and effect boundary and the identity of the stop authority without publishing sensitive technical details.
migration_concerns: Do not treat a prompt that accurately states internet access as authorisation to attack the internet.
Do not treat a model's situational awareness as a substitute for provider and evaluator containment duties.
Do not rely solely on configuration declarations; require observed evidence and independent review proportionate to risk.
Do not disclose live credentials, sensitive topology, active vulnerabilities, or operational attack paths in public assurance records.
Do not collapse provider, partner, model, monitor, and stop-authority responsibility into one undifferentiated owner.
Do not create a PATCH until exact adopted wording and commit-addressed verification exist.
dependencies: Human review of the proposed reality-binding boundary and the minimum evidence required for elevated and critical evaluations.
Surgical drafting against current canonical Caelestis instruments at or after commit c4bb588ca39093ebf6dea01d11ab93f5cb1fcdc7.
Independent security review of feasible preflight and continuous verification without exposing sensitive environment detail.
Coordination with existing OPERATIONS-008, OPERATIONS-007, Annex K, runtime, logging, and incident controls to avoid duplicate state machines.

external_relevance.external_summary: Relevant to model providers and evaluation partners that must prove that simulation, target-scope, connectivity, credential, monitoring, and production-separation claims remain true in the actual runtime rather than only in prompts, plans, or intended topology.

resolution_status.resolution_note: Proposal remains open pending human review, adopted Caelestis wording, and commit-addressed verification. Existing OPERATIONS-008 controls provide strong partial coverage but do not complete the proposed reality-binding integration.

next_action: Conduct a surgical Caelestis drafting review limited to the verified gap across OPERATIONS-008, OPERATIONS-007, AEON-003-SCH-02, Annex K, and OPERATIONS-001-SUP-01. Define the smallest environment-attestation, contradiction, revalidation, and stop-state additions; create a PATCH only after adoption and commit-addressed verification.
